description: Quote and execute a trade. Policy runs before anything is signed: a refusal returns the reason and costs nothing. Attach takeProfit and stopLoss to ship the exit with the entry.

maxSlippage.description: Largest acceptable adverse move as a fraction, e.g. 0.003. Exceeding it rejects the order instead of filling it worse.

notional.description: How much to spend, e.g. "300 USDG".

window.description: twap: window to spread across, e.g. "30m".
